title: Towards Better Dental AI: A Multimodal Benchmark and Instruction Dataset for Panoramic X-ray Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy and performance of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) across five distinct clinical diagnostic dimensions (Teeth, Pathological findings, Historical treatments, Jawbone observations, and Clinical summary) to identify performance disparities based on anatomical focus and granularity.
